description: This file defines an interface `SortOptionEntry` representing a single entry used to specify sorting options based on property paths and sort order, including static methods for creating ascending and descending sort entries, and an enum for sort order types.

classes.name: SortOptionEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a sort option entry, including methods to get sort order, property path, and string representation.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: Enumeration of sort orders, with values ASC for ascending and DESC for descending.

methods.name: asc
methods.description: Static method to create a sort option entry with ascending order for a given property path.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Static method to create a sort option entry with descending order for a given property path.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order (ASC or DESC) for this entry.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path associated with this sort option entry.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the sort option entry, e.g., '+thingId' or '-property'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name of the sort order ('+' or '-').
